_comment: Copy to config/config.json and fill in. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the server. Restart the service after any change: config is only read at startup. chmod 600 the real file; it holds secrets.
_comment_optional_paths: browse_root: sandbox for the 'Browse the Mac' picker (default: home dir). output_root: per-build output dirs (default: <builds_root>/output); point at the USB drive if you like.
_comment_retention: Keep at most this many build output dirs per project; 0 = keep all. Default 10.
_comment_security: build_token: required by the UI/API for builds and edits. gitea_webhook_secret: must match the Secret on the Gitea webhook; empty = signatures not checked.
_comment_ios_testflight: Optional; needed only for Distribute / auto-distribute. Must be a TEAM key (App Store Connect -> Users and Access -> Integrations -> Team Keys), not an Individual key.
_comment_android_keystores: Optional; needed only for release-signed Android builds. KEYED BY KEYSTORE PATH, exactly as typed in the project's 'Keystore path' field. store_pass = password of the keystore file. key_pass = password of the key (the project's 'Key alias') inside it; omit it if it equals store_pass, which is always the case for PKCS12 keystores. 'default' applies to any keystore with no entry of its own.
_comment_adb: Optional. Default: adb on PATH (brew install android-platform-tools), else the adb bundled with a Hub editor's Android module.
